title: Work Done by Kinetic Friction

variables.W_{f_k}: Dissipative interfacial work of kinetic friction
variables.s_{\\text{rel}}: Relative sliding displacement distance between contacting surfaces

assumptions: Constant normal force along sliding distance
conditions_of_validity: Dry sliding contact obeying Amontons-Coulomb law
common_misuse: Using ground-frame displacement instead of relative interfacial displacement s_rel
